thread:
mia_chen: quick check — embeddings proxy looks like it's writing a handful of sampling traces to the debug bucket. are we redacting emails in request bodies before those traces are stored? i spotted a few user emails in recent samples.

samir: we should be, but my understanding is the scrubber runs after response generation and might miss raw request fields for embedding pipelines. tagging @jordan to confirm how the proxy samples.

jordan: yep — edge proxy strips Authorization/Cookie headers, but bodies for embeddings go into the sampling pipeline pre-scrub in some paths. we do have a scrubber stage, but it doesn't currently apply the email regex to raw input text for embeddings. do you have an example? :eyes: 

mia_chen: example (anonymized): ```{"user_id":12345, "text":"please send the report to alice@example.com when ready"}``` — saw this in a staging sample.

alex_r: proposed fix: add an additional scrub pass for embedding requests that runs regex-based PII removal on free-text fields before any sample write. regex we use elsewhere is `(?i)[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Z]{2,}` — also add phone patterns. plus we should hash user_id and not store raw ids.

samir: two asks: (1) can telemetry team patch scrubber and add unit tests? (2) i need a security sign-off to enable full-body sampling on staging for 48h to validate scrub effectiveness. not enabling on prod.

security-bot: checklist for approval request: 1) confirm Authorization/Token headers are removed at edge (yes/no) 2) confirm user_id is hashed/pseudonymized before storage 3) provide proposed regex and test cases (to avoid false positives) 4) sampling bucket retention <= 7 days for this debug run 5) log the approval and duration in the ticket.

jordan: created ticket INF-4892 with sample, regex proposal, and rollout plan: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4892 — requesting security review and 48h staging logging permission.

alex_r: i'll open a PR to telemetry with the extra scrub pass, tests, and a metric for scrub failures. plan is: scrub -> sample -> write. if scrub fails, drop the sample and emit a metric.

security-bot: quick note: do not enable full-body logging in prod under any circumstance. once PR is up, ping this thread with PR link + test artifacts. if all checklist items pass we can approve 48h staging window and will record it.

mia_chen: thanks all — will wait for the PR then ping. :thumbsup:
